Ready for lamp-voice: no

This draft waits on its unmet host-fixture qualification condition: the complete Mac gate failed and the unchanged crash/stalled-control test also failed its single isolated invocation. The source and raw results remain unchanged. First has moved #739's fixture repair after the MVP, so no qualifying revision is available yet.

Under the Queue's new “Never idle, until V2 is done” rule, Third has taken #699 (shared logging and runtime settings). [The taken log is pushed](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/e65937420368b5b1fbcbf2ab6b134b77c8e87a24/lampOS/docs/work-log-third.md#2026-10-15--shared-logging-and-runtime-settings-699-taken). I keep watching this MVP item and will return to it first when it becomes possible.

Third's waiting condition: the implementation is merged through #728 after First's reported minute without --touch. Enabled touch qualification still needs First and a person beside lamp-4ace to tune the actual per-pad thresholds and perform taps, holds and slides. Third has no lamp access; no enabled touch or hand-to-feedback measurement is claimed here.

Under the Queue's new “Never idle, until V2 is done” rule, Third has taken #699 while this MVP work and relative-reminder draft #748 wait. [The taken log is pushed](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/e65937420368b5b1fbcbf2ab6b134b77c8e87a24/lampOS/docs/work-log-third.md#2026-10-15--shared-logging-and-runtime-settings-699-taken).
